# Rufus Vane

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old eighteen years ago (around thirty-five years old)  <sub>[v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c32 P3](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0003), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Nova Scotia  <sub>[v4 c32 P11](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0011), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>
- **Role:** Sailor  <sub>[v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

As a youth, Rufus was slim with high cheek color and pale hair. He shared identical facial traits and an ocular quirk—one hazel eye and one blue eye—with his double cousin Laurence Vane, though Rufus was slightly shorter and less plump.

_Sources: [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

In his youth, Rufus was known as a scamp who pulled pranks alongside his cousin Laurence. He was generally considered less pleasant than Laurence and lacked a broad popularity among the local residents.

_Sources: [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Traits

- Mischievous  <sub>[v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>
- Prankster  <sub>[v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>

## Abilities

- Seamanship  <sub>[v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)</sub>

## History

Eighteen years prior, at around seventeen years of age, Rufus visited his Uncle Abner. He sowed crops at the farm before departing on the vessel *Four Sisters* for Havana, Cuba. Upon reaching Cuba, Rufus contracted yellow fever. His double cousin, Laurence Vane, remained behind in Cuba to care for him while the vessel departed. Rufus died of the disease shortly thereafter. For eleven years, the community of Seven Gulls mistakenly believed that Laurence Vane—who had survived a violent injury with severe memory loss and a altered appearance—was Rufus Vane returned home.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c32 P3](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0003), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Background by volume

- Son of Abner Vane's brother and twin sister of Laurence Vane's mother  <sub>[v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>
- Double cousin of Laurence Vane  <sub>[v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>
- Engaged or married to Lorna Vane  <sub>[v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c32 P3](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0003)</sub>
- Sailed aboard the vessel Four Sisters to Cuba  <sub>[v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)</sub>
